## Which Dynamics Are Being Differentiated?

In a local state chart, let $x\in\mathbb R^n$, $u\in\mathbb R^m$ and

$$
\dot x=F(x,u,t)=f(x,t)+\sum_{j=1}^m b_j(x,t)u_j.
$$

Choose a feasible nominal solution $(x^\star(t),u^\star(t))$. The first variation is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dot{\delta x}&=A(t)\delta x+B(t)\delta u,\\
A&=D_xf+\sum_j u_j^\star D_xb_j,\\
B&=[b_1,\ldots,b_m].
\end{aligned}
$$

with every derivative evaluated on that nominal solution. State-dependent input fields contribute to $A$. For $\dot x=x^2+xu$, the correct scalar Jacobian is $2x^\star+u^\star$; at $(x^\star,u^\star)=(2,3)$ it is $7$, not $4$.

If the implemented command is $u=\pi(x,t)$, differentiate the complete field $F(x,\pi(x,t),t)$. Delays, filters and actuator states can require an augmented state; the nominal open-loop Jacobian is not automatically the feedback Jacobian.

## Sampling Is a Modeling Choice

For period $h>0$, start time $t_k=kh$, and a zero-order hold,

$$
x_{k+1}=F_k(x_k,u_k)=\Phi(t_k+h;t_k,x_k,u_k).
$$

Then $A_k=D_xF_k$ and $B_k=D_uF_k$ give

$$
\delta x_{k+1}=A_k\delta x_k+B_k\delta u_k.
$$

A nonautonomous flow retains absolute start time. For $\dot x=tu$, exact integration yields $F_k=x_k+u_k(t_kh+h^2/2)$. With $h=0.2$, $u_k=3$, the increments are $0.06$ at start time zero and $0.66$ at start time one. These are synthetic arithmetic examples.

## From First Variation to Finite Error

The differential of the flow maps one tangent space into another. In charts the displayed matrices represent that map; they need not be interpreted as subtracting vectors at unrelated base points. Finite state differences incur a remainder. Check numerical derivatives over a useful range of step sizes and compare finite perturbations against nonlinear rollout. A derivative check verifies implementation locally; it does not establish a region of validity.

For golf, event timing matters. Comparing both swings at the same clock time and comparing both at impact are different output maps. Include event sensitivity before attributing a difference in club delivery to a particular state or command.
